sources.entry: iTunesConnect - macOS app to let you access iTunesConnect.

summary.one_liner: A macOS app that gives access to iTunes Connect, with a README that is very short and describes little beyond its purpose.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes this as a Mac OS X app for accessing iTunesConnect. It lists version 1.1 as the current release. It also lists planned features that are not yet built: multiple tabs, saving the last session, and a Notification Center integration intended to show statistics. The README does not describe the implementation, the languages used, or detailed usage. It has no install or build instructions.
use_cases: accessing iTunes Connect from a Mac
viewing App Store Connect-style statistics on macOS
notable: Mac OS X app for iTunesConnect access
caveats: README is very short and gives no setup or build instructions
Planned features (tabs, session saving, Notification Center) are listed as wanted, not implemented
keywords: view app store stats on mac
